title: Te Ope Taua i Tūtaki ki te Ure Rere
intro: I te wā i mua i te Poropiti a Muhammad, i whakarewahia e tētahi rangatira kaha o Yemen tētahi pakanga hōia e whai ana kia whakangaromia tētahi wāhi tapu i Makkah. Nā tēnei hoariri i ārahi tētahi ope nui me ngā arewhana whawhai, e whakapono ana ki tō rātou kaha me te tokomaha. Heoi, ka mutu ohorere tā rātou haerenga i te tūtakitanga ki tētahi wawaotanga atua kāore i te tumanakohia. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi ko wai i tūtaki ki tēnei whakatau tata whakamiharo?
clues: I haere tahi mātou me tētahi ope taua nui me ngā arewhana pakanga kaha ki te whare tapu
I whakaaro mātou ki te hutia ake, ki te whakangaro hoki i tētahi wāhi karakia i hangaia e ngā pononga a te Atua Aroha Nui.
I tukuna mai he kahui manu ririki ki a mātou, me te mau i ngā kōhatu paru i roto i ō rātou ngutu me ō rātou maikuku.
I tūtaki mātou ki tētahi haruru i aki mai i ngā kōhatu ki runga i a mātou, i huri ai mātou hei toenga kua takatakahia
Nō te whenua o Yemen ahau, ā, i mahi ahau i raro i tētahi rangatira i whai kia tiakina te wāhi tapu.
I waiho mātou hei tauira mā te hunga e maia ana ki te whakakore i te wāhi tapu o Allah.
